tone.target: Edge-style dotted delay clean with chimey breakup
tone.profile: Edge-style dotted delay clean with chimey breakup
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain utilizing a Vox-style amp model (UK 45) for chime, followed by light compression, and centered around a dotted eighth note digital delay. Room reverb adds subtle space without sounding too big.
